description: Look up one Monero transaction by txid: is it mined, in which block, how many confirmations, its size, output count and ring size. When to use: did this XMR transfer get into a block, and how deep is it now. Do not use: to learn the amount or the sender/recipient - Monero hides those by design and no third party can recover them; only the recipient (or a holder of the tx key) can prove a payment. Returns: found, confirmed, in_mempool, block_height, block_timestamp, confirmations, double_spend_seen, size_bytes, inputs, outputs, ring_size_per_input, tx_version, unlock_time, and explicitly the list of fields not disclosed by the protocol.
name: xmr_get_transaction
